literal_edit.old: For every m>=1 an ordinary integer matrix with the same exact margins and rank98 can be chosen whose Gram is H modulo3^m, with coherent successive residues.
literal_edit.replacement: For every m>=1 an ordinary integer matrix M_m with the same exact margins and rank_F3(M_m mod3)=98 can be chosen whose Gram is H modulo3^m, with coherent successive residues.

original_statement: For every symmetric integer 99-by-99 matrix H with Hj=21j whose ternary reduction G satisfies Gj=0, G^2-G=2J and rank(G)=55, there exists a 99-by-231 matrix M over the 3-adic integers with MM^T=H, M1=7j, M^Tj=3*1 and rank_F3(M)=98. For every m>=1 an ordinary integer matrix with the same exact margins and rank98 can be chosen whose Gram is H modulo3^m, with coherent successive residues. This does not require or assert binary entries, nonnegative entries, triangle supports, or an ordinary integer exact-Gram factor.
revision2_statement: For every symmetric integer 99-by-99 matrix H with Hj=21j whose ternary reduction G satisfies Gj=0, G^2-G=2J and rank(G)=55, there exists a 99-by-231 matrix M over the 3-adic integers with MM^T=H, M1=7j, M^Tj=3*1 and rank_F3(M)=98. For every m>=1 an ordinary integer matrix M_m with the same exact margins and rank_F3(M_m mod3)=98 can be chosen whose Gram is H modulo3^m, with coherent successive residues. This does not require or assert binary entries, nonnegative entries, triangle supports, or an ordinary integer exact-Gram factor.
